info.description: The read API of Observe. Sign in with the console (a session cookie) or send a read token as `Authorization: Bearer wpr_...`. Responses carry an ETag; send it back in If-None-Match to get a 304. Lists are `{items, next_cursor}`. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details. Changes are additive within /api/v2.
info.title: Observe API
